definitions.explanation: The date when a product, such as a book, game, or movie, becomes available for purchase or viewing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{発売日|はつばいび}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
examples.english: The release date for the new game has been decided.
I lined up in front of the store on the release date.

examples.japanese: {発売日|はつばいび}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{延期|えんき}→延期：01888_enki⟧⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧⟦がっかりした→がっかりする：21758_gakkarisuru⟧。
examples.english: I was disappointed that the release date was postponed.

notes:
{発売日|はつばいび} is the date when a product becomes available for purchase. Commonly used for games, books, CDs, movies, and consumer electronics.

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{発売|はつばい}→発売：04315_hatsubai⟧ (sale, release) + {日|び} (day).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {発売日|はつばいび}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まる→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧: the release date is set
- {発売日|はつばいび}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{延期|えんき}される→延期する：02517_enkisuru⟧: the release date is postponed
- {発売日|はつばいび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy on release day
- {発売日|はつばいび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧: to line up on release day

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{発売|はつばい}→発売：04315_hatsubai⟧: release, sale
- ⟦{発売|はつばい}→発売：04315_hatsubai⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧: before release (pre-release)
- ⟦{発売|はつばい}{中|ちゅう}→発売中：22137_hatsubaichuu⟧: now on sale
- ⟦{発売|はつばい}{開始|かいし}→発売開始：22166_hatsubaikaishi⟧: start of sales

SIMILAR DATE COMPOUNDS:
- {公開日|こうかいび}: release date (for movies, websites)
- ⟦{締切日|しめきりび}→締切日：21906_shimekiribi⟧: deadline
